title: Crema Catalana
summary: A silky Spanish citrus custard scented with lemon and orange, finished with a crisp caramelised sugar crust. It’s a classic vegetarian dessert for when you want something creamy, bright, and elegant.
steps: Put the milk, lemon zest, orange zest, and cinnamon in a saucepan. Warm over medium heat until steaming, then remove from the heat and let it infuse for 10 minutes.
In a bowl, whisk the egg yolks, sugar, cornstarch, salt, and vanilla extract until smooth and pale.
Strain the warm milk into the egg mixture, whisking constantly, then pour everything back into the saucepan.
Cook over low to medium-low heat, stirring continuously, until the custard thickens and just begins to bubble. Do not let it boil hard.
Divide the custard between 4 shallow ramekins and smooth the tops. Chill for at least 1 hour, or until fully set.

Just before serving, sprinkle a thin, even layer of sugar over each custard and caramelise it with a kitchen blowtorch or under a hot grill until golden and crisp. Let the sugar harden for 1 to 2 minutes, then serve.
